$comment: Accepted dependency advisories. Each entry records that a human reviewed the advisory and chose a disposition. The gate fails when an advisory is NOT listed here, and also when a listed advisory no longer applies — so a fix must delete its own excuse. Regenerate with: bun scripts/check-vulnerabilities.mjs --update-baseline

GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm.reason: No fixed version is published: braces 3.0.3 is the latest release, so there is nothing to pin to and `bun audit fix` reports it as unfixable. Reachable only through micromatch → fast-glob → @ts-morph/common → ts-morph inside the `vercel` CLI's tree, which is a devDependency and is not shipped. The related brace-expansion advisory in the same subtree did have a fix and has been resolved.
